newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Fralex sells Elandsfontein for 66 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Fralex sells Elandsfontein for 66 mln rand.

text.p: South African industrial and engineering holdings group Fralex Ltd said on Thursday it had agreed to sell its Elandsfontein Colliery and associated mineral and surface rights for 66.4 million rand with effect July 1.
The group said a recent strategic review had decided the firm should retire from direct involvement in coal mining.
"The disposal will allow the group to focus more closely on its core business and to relinquish control of a business operation which competes with its group customers," the firm said in a statement.
No buyer of the group was detailed in the announcement and a spokeswoman for the firm said the information was unavailable.
The proceeds of the sale are to go to pay off group debt.
The deal will be settled by an initial payment of 50 million rand, 3.4 million rand over the next 18 months and the balance over the operating life of the mine based on future coal sales.
